name: Kaen'in Reika
source:
A strong-willed young lady. She tends to try to look good to those around her.
She has two close aides and a few cronies.
She does not get along well with Ayane Hino (Ayane has no interest in her), is hostile toward her, and often harasses her.
His father is a city councillor and donates a large amount of money to the school.
Therefore, there is no one at the school who can resist him.
Incidentally, the protagonist has tutored Reika in the past.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.ume.gr.jp/product/dz/paradox/paradox.html]the official site[/url]]
